notes.title: The great update
notes.content:
[h1]New Environment [/h1]

Trying to escape classes can be tough. But looking at the new view outside the school can help. Each class was designed again from scratch with new and higher quality textures and graphics.

[h1]New Puzzles added[/h1]

Newly designed puzzles added in each room for some new brain challenges.

[h1]Existing puzzles redesigned[/h1]

After watching a ton of players solve our puzzles, getting their feedback, and learning more on how you process and reason through the puzzles, each puzzle was redesigned to include more of what was found to be fun and exclude some aspects that were not as interesting to the players.

[h1]Other improvements[/h1]

Improved save system, more optimization, more convenient mechanics, improved player movement, etc.
